crossRefs.note: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them: for he who has mercy on them will lead…
They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;

translations.web: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
translations.bsb: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
translations.kjv: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
translations.asv: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.
